name: Protopasta Glass Fiber HTPETG
filament_notes:
Glass Fiber HTPETG (White, Highfive Blue). Product page: same guidance as the carbon-fiber HTPETG - nozzle up to 300C, bed 100C+, flow below 100% and a nozzle wipe at layer change to limit buildup. Higher heat resistance than Glass Fiber PCTG.
This profile still uses Proto-Pasta's standard PETG numbers (250C, 80C plate, 12 mm3/s cap), which are below the product page's guidance - expect to raise the nozzle and bed temperatures.
Dry before printing. Hard steel nozzle required (abrasive). Use glue stick.
